html:
A Tuareg uprising led by Kaocen ag Geda, which besieged the French garrison at Agadez from December 1916 to March 1917.

Kaocen was backed by the Senussi order of Libya and the Ottomans, who were at war with France in the First World War. Many Tuareg of the Air rose with him, angry at French taxes and the requisition of camels for the war. A relief column from Zinder broke the siege, and the French took terrible revenge on the people of the Air and Agadez. Kaocen fled north and was killed in 1919. In Niger he is honoured as a hero of resistance.
sum: A Tuareg uprising led by Kaocen ag Geda, which besieged the French garrison at Agadez from December 1916 to March 1917.
